pure_scope: One GPU, balanced static expert tasks, BF16 inputs/output and FP32 accumulation. CUDA Graph replay; 50 ms cooldown, 2 s spaced warmup, 30 samples per implementation per process, two orders. cuBLAS strided-batched GEMM with reduced-precision reduction disabled. Allocation excluded from pure GEMM events.
full_scope: EP8/EP16, tokens per rank. Native/Flex share a 1620 MHz clock ceiling and 700 W budget. Wall time includes fixed input/output tensor allocation; persistent buffers, contexts and initial setup are excluded. No cooldown inserted into operator timings.
diagnostic_note: Formal measurements use after_source. Later diagnostic-only changes strengthen finite checking and balance partial N groups; the final diagnostics passed all 40 full-output/reference/repeat checks. Production source is unchanged. The generic FC2 measurements use this later diagnostic; primary model timings have not been rerun after its scheduler cleanup.
